description.value: Quiznos is a national toasted-sandwich chain that has been operating since 1981, known for hot subs made with fresh, high-quality ingredients served on toasted bread. This Lower Mainland location offers a range of subs, sliders, salads, and soups, with takeout as the primary service model. Cyclists looking for a quick, filling sandwich stop may find it a practical option along a route through the area.
